items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 營收指引區間 2.45–2.55 億美元
items.quote: between $245 million and $255 million.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 non-GAAP EPS 指引 2.34–2.48 美元
items.quote: Non-GAAP earnings per diluted share to range from $2.34 to
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表示客戶排程考量使上半年偏高、下半年預期更高
items.quote: we expect the second half to run higher
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 讀 WFE 今年中十位數成長，高於 2 月看法，預期 Nova 表現優於此數
items.quote: we expect WFE to reach mid-teens growth
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明 Q1 毛利率與其驅動因素（產品組合與服務成長）
items.quote: blended gross margins were 57.7% on a GAAP basis
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 Q1 營業利益率超過目標模型上緣 28%–33%
items.quote: reached 30% on a GAAP basis and 34% on a non-GAAP basis
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 答全年毛利率會落在與上半年指引相同的區間、可持續
items.quote: we see gross margins for 2026 will be within the same rate
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 解釋 Q2 毛利率指引 59% 較 Q1 低的口徑：指引通常上下 1%
items.quote: guiding, it's plus/minus 1%. So it's within the same
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給 Q2 費用與稅率指引：non-GAAP 營業費用增至約 6,600 萬美元、稅率約 15%
items.quote: Effective tax rate is expected to be approximately 15%.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 重申 2027 年營收 10 億美元的策略目標仍在軌道上，且不提供更遠指引
items.quote: we are on track, of course, to reach this
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 重申 GAA 累計 5 億美元營收目標在軌道上，並稱 2027 年 GAA 投資較今年成長
items.quote: we're on track for the forecasted $500 million cumulative
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱客戶更早規劃，部分已下單並規劃 2027 年交貨，能見度提高
items.quote: we do have improved visibility towards next year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱有拉貨使上半年高於原預期，交貨時點由客戶需求結構決定
items.quote: We do see some pull-ins, by the way, driving the first half
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 揭露 Q1 營收組合 Logic/Foundry 約 66%、Memory 約 34%
items.quote: Revenue mix was approximately 66% from Logic and Foundry
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 預期今年 Memory 占比較去年更高，由先進 DRAM 投資帶動
items.quote: I expect Memory to become more dominant this year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱中國占營收比重預期下降，長期穩定在 25%–30%，今年較上季有正向動能
items.quote: we expect China to stabilize in the range of 25% to 30%
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 Nova 獲 Intel EPIC 供應商獎
items.quote: Nova was awarded the Intel EPIC
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 稱有 4 家客戶與 5 個地區各占產品營收逾 10%
items.quote: 4 customers and 5 geographic regions, each
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 引 Gartner 報告稱膜厚與 CD 量測市占再增 400 bp，為第二大供應商
items.quote: an additional 400 basis points share gain
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 承認 XPS 與材料量測出現競爭，含中國本土廠商與其他潛在新進者
items.quote: We are also seeing emerging XPS and material metrology
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱中國市場競爭激烈，Nova 以產品與擁有成本作為差異化
items.quote: China is also a very competitive market, as you know.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱交期仍短於部分同業
items.quote: Our lead times are still shorter than some of our peers
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱先進封裝已接近產品營收的 20% 中段，多數來自 Logic
items.quote: advanced packaging for Nova is edging towards the mid-20s
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱先進 DRAM 約占 Memory 業務 2/3，Metrion 平台創紀錄
items.quote: approximately 2/3 of our memory business
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱混合鍵合採用速度快於預期，量測密集度高
items.quote: Adoption is progressing faster than expected
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱部分客戶（尤其 Memory）對混合鍵合有拉貨
items.quote: We do see some pull-ins for hybrid bonding
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱服務營收創紀錄，連續第 13 季季增
items.quote: marking the 13th consecutive
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱亞洲新廠預計 2026 年底前後投產，目標擴產、優化成本、區域負載平衡
items.quote: The new facility is expected to become operational
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 承認供應鏈有壓力並正與數家供應商協調
items.quote: We see, I would say, some pressure on the
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱供應商端出現成本壓力，主因晶片價格上漲，以成本管理因應
items.quote: some cost pressure at the supplier level, mainly tied to the
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 答分析師質疑製程管制強度時稱今年製程管制表現尚難判斷
items.quote: it's too early to say how process control looks like
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 稱 Q1 稅率約 17%，略高於指引，預期正常化
items.quote: We expect this dynamic to normalize as the year
items.speaker: CFO

qa_flags.question: Needham 問中國今年預期（前次為持平到小增）是否改變
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未直接回答是否調整先前說法，也未給數字，改談中國占比下降、長期 25–30%、封裝新客戶及「some potential growth」

qa_flags.question: Morgan Stanley 問今年製程管制強度偏低下如何優於 WFE
qa_flags.response_pattern: 稱「too early to call」，未給優於 WFE 的幅度，改談製程與製程管制兩條成長線

qa_flags.question: Barclays 問 Q2 毛利率指引較 Q1 下降的原因
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未說明驅動因素，僅稱指引通常上下 1%、屬同一量級

qa_flags.question: BofA 問全年成長相對 WFE 與 Memory/Logic 組合
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給全年成長數字，僅稱預期優於 WFE 並重申 2027 年 10 億美元目標
